answer_1.quote: Open-ended text generation tasks involve generating coherent and fluent output ... applications such as chit-chat dialog, story generation ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of our generated texts using various automatic metrics, including diversity, MAUVE, coherence, greedy ratio, and gen-length.

answer_3.quote: We employ the large language model text-davinci-003 to overcome these limitations as an evaluator surrogate... The LLM then assesses and determines whether completion A is better than completion B based on criteria such as consistency, fluency, and informativeness.

answer_4.quote: We engaged two English language experts... The experts should assess and select superior sentences based on three criteria: consistency, fluency, and informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compare two generated completions and choose the better one according to consistency, fluency, and informativeness.
